WPSS/1827/2026
Kirtan Pal
--Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand
--Respondent
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. M.S. Pal, learned Senior Advocate assisted 
by Ms. Amreen Bano, learned Counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Dinesh Bankoti, learned B.H. for the State.
3. It is contended by learned Counsel for the 
petitioner that earlier, petitioner had filed WPSS 
No.3280 of 2018 which was decided by this Court vide 
judgment and order dated 19.11.2025 along with 
several other writ petitions, directing the petitioner(s)
to move a representation to the competent authority 
who shall look into their claim and take appropriate 
decision, as per law, within six months from the date 
of filing of representation. 
4. It is reflected from the order dated 18.05.2026 
(Annexure No.1 to the petition) that prior to decision 
of writ petition of petitioners on 19.11.2025, a 
Division Bench of this Court had passed an order on 
19.12.2023 where-upon the benefit of grade pay was 
paid to the petitioners of that writ petition. 
5. It is contended by learned Senior Counsel for the 
petitioner that petitioner has yet not been paid the 
Grade Pay of Rs.2800/-, while the said contention  raised on being of petitioner is being disputed by 
learned State Counsel on the basis of order dated 
18.05.2026, wherein it is stated that the benefit of 
Grade Pay of Rs.2800/- has already been paid to the 
petitioners of all the writ petitions which have been 
decided by this Court and batch; and budget is also 
sought from the Chief Engineer (Finance Controller) 
Irrigation Department, Uttarakhand, Dehradun for 
payment of arrears to the petitioners; and as and 
when the budget shall be made available, payment of 
arrears shall be made to the petitioners. 
6. Learned State Counsel shall get specific order 
whereby petitioner Kirtan Pal was sanctioned the 
benefit of Grade Pay of Rs.2800/- pursuant to the 
decision of his writ petition. 
7. List on 27.07.2026 as fresh.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 15.07.2026 R.Dang

3. It is contended by learned State Counsel that despite

4. In such view of the matter, put up on 29.07.2026 as

5. In case instructions are not received before the office 
of learned C.S.C., then respondent no. 2, Superintending

--Petitioner
Versus
State Of Uttarakhand and Others
--Respondents
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Ms. Amreen Bano, learned counsel 
for petitioner.
2. Mr. Dinesh Bankoti, learned Brief 
Holder for the State of Uttarakhand/ 
respondents.
3. This Court asked for instruction from 
the respondents-State.
4. Learned State Counsel passed on to 
this Court written instruction dated 
21.07.2026, which is taken on record, 
and submitted that benefit of Grade Pay 
of ₹2800/- was given to petitioner and 
the matter was forwarded to the 
Engineer-in-Chief, Irrigation 
Department, Uttarakhand, vide letter 
dated 17.06.2026.
5. Now, the question involved in the 
present writ petition is that the said 
benefit of Grade Pay of ₹2800/- was paid
to petitioner along with arrears, if any, 
or not.
6. Learned counsel for petitioner at this 
stage submits that petitioner has also 
claimed grant of Grade Pay of ₹4200/-
after payment of Grade Pay of ₹2800/-. 7. The said fact is disputed by learned 
State Counsel stating that petitioner is 
not entitled to get Grade Pay of ₹4200/-.
8. In such view of the matter, learned 
State Counsel shall file a detailed 
counter affidavit within six weeks.
9. Put up on 21.09.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 29.07.2026
